name: Claude Education Skills Library
description: 108 evidence-based pedagogical skills for educators — the only education-specific skills library in the Claude ecosystem. Covers curriculum design, lesson planning, assessment, learning science, wellbeing, EAL, professional learning, and AI tutoring design across 14 domains. Every skill is grounded in named peer-reviewed research with explicit evidence ratings. Frameworks without empirical support (learning styles, brain gym, VAK) are excluded by design. Agent Skills 1.0 compliant with progressive disclosure, auto-activation, typed YAML schemas, and chaining metadata. Live MCP server included. CC BY-SA 4.0.
longDescription:
Ships **165 skills**.

- **Skills** (165): `adaptive-hint-sequence-designer` (Generate a cascading hint sequence for a problem type, revealing progressively without giving answers), `ai-facilitated-collaborative-learning-designer` (Design AI-supported collaborative tasks that structure group interaction and address participation problems), `ai-feedback-design-principles` (Audit and redesign AI-generated feedback for pedagogical quality, timing, and learning impact), `cognitive-tutoring-architecture-designer` (Map knowledge components and skill hierarchies for a cognitive tutoring system or adaptive learning platform), `digital-worked-example-sequence` (Create an interactive digital worked example sequence with fading for online or blended delivery), `erroneous-example-designer` (Design deliberately flawed examples that develop error-detection skills and deepen understanding), `formative-assessment-loop-designer` (Design an adaptive assessment loop where each student response triggers the next instructional move), `individual-spacing-algorithm-explainer` (Explain and configure individual spacing algorithms using student performance data and forgetting curves), and 157 more

Installs with `claude plugin install claude-education-skills-library@claude-community` from `GarethManning/claude-education-skills`.
